record.original_question: Let Cl(R^d) be the compact metric space of closed subsets of R^d with the Chabauty-Fell topology. Determine all Borel probability measures on Cl(R^d) that are invariant under the natural action of SL_d(R), and likewise determine all such measures invariant under the natural action of ASL_d(R).

evidence.quote: Let d ≥ 1 be an integer. Denote by Cl(Rd ) the set of all closed subsets of Rd with respect to the Chabauty–Fell topology [1]. Thus, Cl(Rd ) is a compact metric space and any group acting on Rd acts on it by transporting closed sets. Let SLd (R) denote the group of matrices in dimension d with determinant one, viz. the group of all volume and orientation preserving linear transformations in Rd . Let ASLd (R) denote the affine group in Rd , viz. the group of all orientation and volume preserving affine maps in Rd .
Problem 2.8.1 (J. Marklof). Determine all SLd(R)–invariant Borel probability measures on Cl(Rd) and similarly for the ASLd(R) action.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 1$ be an integer and let $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ denote the set of all closed subsets of $\mathbb{R}^d$, equipped with the Chabauty–Fell topology (a sub-basis is given, for each compact $K \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ and each open $U \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, by the sets $\{F \in \mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d) : F \cap K = \emptyset\}$ and $\{F \in \mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d) : F \cap U \neq \emptyset\}$). With this topology $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ is a compact metrizable space. Let $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$ denote the group of $d \times d$ real matrices of determinant one, acting on $\mathbb{R}^d$ by linear transformations, and let $\mathrm{ASL}_d(\mathbb{R}) = \mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R}) \ltimes \mathbb{R}^d$ denote the group of orientation- and volume-preserving affine transformations of $\mathbb{R}^d$. Each of these groups acts on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ by the induced action $g \cdot F = \{g(x) : x \in F\}$.

Classify all Borel probability measures on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ that are invariant under the action of $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$, and likewise classify all Borel probability measures on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ that are invariant under the action of $\mathrm{ASL}_d(\mathbb{R})$.
artifact.category_tag: Invariant measures for group actions on spaces of closed subsets
artifact.status_search_result: No full classification appears in the literature. Examples of such invariant ergodic measures (the Ratner–Marklof–Strömbergsson measures supported on cut-and-project sets) are known, and Solan–Solomon–Weiss (IMRN 2017) studied the topological dynamics of the $\mathrm{ASL}_d(\mathbb{R})$ action on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$, showing the only minimal subsystems are the fixed points $\{\emptyset\}$ and $\{\mathbb{R}^d\}$. However, a complete classification of all invariant Borel probability measures has not been found.

status_evidence.title: On problems of Danzer and Gowers and dynamics on the space of closed subsets of R^d
status_evidence.snippet: Considering the space of closed subsets of R^d, endowed with the Chabauty-Fell topology, and the affine action of SL_d(R) ⋉ R^d, we prove that the only minimal subsystems are the fixed points {∅} and {R^d}.
status_evidence.claim: Provides results on topological dynamics of the same action but does not classify invariant probability measures.

status_evidence.title: Classification and statistics of cut-and-project sets
status_evidence.snippet: Ratner–Marklof–Strömbergsson measures are probability measures supported on cut-and-project sets in R^d which are invariant and ergodic for ASL_d(R) or SL_d(R).
status_evidence.claim: Known examples of invariant measures exist but classification is incomplete.
